about.title: ABOUT US
about.subtitle: The history, mission, values and people behind Uccelli
about.mission: Uccelli creates an inclusive network that supports education, social exchange, career orientation and personal development. A particular focus is placed on people who have less access to opportunities and supportive networks because of their background or social situation.
about.visionTitle: A community that passes opportunities on
about.vision: We want to build a sustainable network in which people from different backgrounds learn from one another, realise their own ideas and use their skills to strengthen others as well.
about.historyTitle: How encounters grew into a community

history.p1: The idea began in 2015 around Meierhofplatz in Zurich-Höngg. Conversations, shared interests and a desire for belonging led to the group called ‘Strana Uccelli’.
history.p2: Over time, this developed into the vision of an open association that connects people, supports potential and creates room for their own projects. The Uccelli Society was officially founded on 16 July 2021.
history.p3: Uccelli is the Italian word for birds. The name represents freedom, individuality and the belief that different perspectives make a community stronger.

about.valuesIntro: Our projects and relationships are guided by responsibility, openness and mutual respect.

integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.text: We act transparently, reliably and in line with the association's goals.

freedom.title: Freedom and autonomy
freedom.text: People should be able to make their own decisions, take responsibility and shape their personal path.

solidarity.title: Solidarity and cohesion
solidarity.text: We support one another and create connections that also provide strength in challenging situations.

inclusion.title: Inclusion and anti-discrimination
inclusion.text: Everyone is welcome, regardless of origin, gender, religion, sexual orientation or social situation.

environment.title: Environmental awareness
environment.text: We consider ecological impact and promote responsible use of resources.

privacy.title: Privacy and respect
privacy.text: We handle personal information carefully and treat people respectfully and as equals.

about.teamIntro: The team develops projects, maintains partnerships and creates the organisational foundations for the Uccelli community.
about.partnersIntro: Partnerships give our projects access to rooms, expertise, networks and resources. We therefore show not only who we work with, but also what each collaboration contributes.
